web.description: Most security metrics are not built to be used. They are built to be shown. Somewhere between the quarterly review and the next status update, a set of numbers gets assembled that looks reassuring in a room and tells almost no one what is actually happening across the environment that week. Someone pulls them together the week before, cleans them up, and presents a picture of a program that is, as of that one morning, fine.    This is not a failure of effort. web.description: Details have emerged about a new zero-day vulnerability in Cacti , an open-source network monitoring tool, that could be exploited to achieve remote code execution.   The proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit, which has yet to be assigned a CVE identifier, has been tracked as 4HTTP2SHELL  and 4HTTP2ROOT .
